name: smart-grocery-saver

description.zh: 输入家庭人数、周预算、忌口与存货、手上的优惠券，生成一周菜单、按商店拆分的最省钱购物清单、优惠券叠加明细和可发布的小红书省钱笔记。
description.en: Turns household size, weekly budget, dietary needs, pantry and coupons into a weekly meal plan, a store-split optimised shopping list, coupon-stacking savings and a shareable Xiaohongshu-style note.

author: ZQ051031
scenario: Household weekly grocery planning and coupon saving (real-life, recurring every week)

runtime.filesystem: read skill dir; write only to --out

commands.name: plan
commands.usage: python3 scripts/grocery_saver.py plan --input <request.json|-> [--prices prices.csv] [--format json|markdown|note|summary] [--out DIR] [--lang zh|en] [--strict-budget]
commands.description: Build the weekly plan; JSON result follows the output contract below.

commands.name: parse-coupons
commands.description: Convert pasted coupon text into structured coupons.

commands.name: export-prices
commands.description: Export the price table for the user to edit with real prices.

sections.summary: total, budget, remaining, status, baseline_total, savings_total, savings_pct, cost_per_portion, stores_used
sections.meal_plan: per day/meal dishes with estimated cost
sections.shopping_list: per store items (packs, list vs paid cost, applied deals), order discounts, delivery fee; pantry staples to check
sections.savings: baseline definition and step breakdown: pantry, stores, item_coupons, order_coupons
sections.pantry_used / leftovers: stock consumed and what remains for next week
sections.warnings / budget_tips: notes and suggestions when over budget

data.notice: Bundled store names and prices are fictional samples for demonstration, not real or current prices. Users replace them via --prices CSV or price_overrides.

privacy: Runs locally; no network access; no personal data stored.

competition.name: 2026华为开发者大赛·小红书Skill创新赛
